1_incident_name: Silverwood Reservoir Crude Oil Pipeline Rupture
3_safety_message_expanded_safety_message: Focus tactical priority on preventing any oil migration toward the municipal water intake. Night skimming operations must maintain illuminated safety perimeters and 100% life-vest compliance at all times. High vigilance required for steep, oil-covered riprap banks and wildlife hazards.
approved_site_safety_plan_located_at: Incident Command Post at Hesperia Fire Station 30
